turns: What's the difference between the Get Clássica and the Get Smart?
referenceFacts: Get Smart has an Android system and touch screen with management apps
Rental plan without reaching the sales threshold: Get Clássica R$ 79,90 per month, Get Smart R$ 129,90 per month
records.answer:
The main differences between Get Clássica and Get Smart are:

* Faturamento: Get Smart is exclusive for CNPJ with a faturamento above R$10 mil/mês.
* Taxa única: Get Smart has a unique tax rate for the main credit card brands, starting at 3.79% for credit 1x.
* Aluguel: Get Smart has a free aluguel for sales above R$60.000.
* Features: Get Smart has additional features such as cashback, giftback, control of stock, and a system of complete management for the business.
* App: Get Smart has a single app that can be used for payments, printing of fiscal notes, reading of barcodes, and much more.
* Atendimento: Get Smart has a more personalized atendimento, with a team that helps to find and develop a solution tailored to the business.

It's worth noting that Get Clássica and Get Smart have different requirements and features, and the choice between them will depend on the specific needs of the business.

turns: Minha maquininha não conecta na internet
referenceFacts: Steps to restart the card machine (the Get Smart GS-1988-0001 that is offline)
records.answer:
Sua maquininha está configurada para usar a rede Wi-Fi, mas não há sinal desde o último reinício. Ela está com 64% de bateria. O último erro registrado foi "CONEXÃO NÃO ENCONTRADA". Tente reiniciar a maquininha e verifique se a conexão é restabelecida. Se o problema persistir, nossa equipe entrará em contato com você para resolver a situação.

Para reiniciar a maquininha, siga os passos abaixo:

1. Confira a barra de status da maquininha: o ícone de Wi-Fi ou de 4G mostra se há sinal.
2. Reinicie a maquininha: segure o botão de ligar até ela desligar, espere 10 segundos e ligue de novo.
3. Se usa Wi-Fi, confira se o roteador está ligado e se outros aparelhos navegam. Configure a rede de novo nas configurações da maquininha se a senha mudou.
4. Se usa o chip 4G, leve a maquininha para perto de uma janela ou área aberta; balcões de metal e subsolos reduzem o sinal.
5. Troque o modo de conexão (Wi-Fi ↔ chip 4G) para saber se o problema é a rede ou a maquininha.
6. Confira se a bateria está acima de 15%; algumas maquininhas desligam a conexão no modo de economia.
7. Se a maquininha continuar offline depois desses passos, abra um chamado de suporte com o número de série para um técnico verificar o aparelho ou enviar uma troca.

turns: Is my card machine online right now?
referenceFacts: The Get Smart GS-1988-0001 is offline (no Wi-Fi signal since the last restart, 4G chip active)
Suggested steps: restart the machine, check the Wi-Fi router, switch to the 4G chip
records.answer:
Your card machine is currently offline. The last time it was seen online was on 2026-10-30 at 02:01. The machine is using a 4G chip for connectivity, but it's not currently connected to a network. The battery is at 64%. I recommend checking the Wi-Fi connection and restarting the machine to see if it comes back online.

To check if your card machine is online, follow these steps:

1. Check the status bar on your card machine: the Wi-Fi or 4G icon will show if there's a signal.
2. Restart your card machine: press and hold the power button until it turns off, wait 10 seconds, and turn it back on.
3. If using Wi-Fi, check if the router is on and other devices are connected. If the password has changed, configure the network again on your card machine.
4. If using the 4G chip, move the card machine near a window or open area; metal shelves and basements can reduce the signal.
5. Switch between Wi-Fi and 4G modes to see if the issue is with the network or the card machine.
6. Check the battery level: some card machines may disconnect from the network if the battery is low (below 15%).
7. If the card machine remains offline after these steps, open a support ticket with the serial number for a technician to check the device or send a replacement.
